name: AIChipQuick
description: Pill-shaped suggested-prompt chip with Lucide icon + label for AI idle state. Standard and isSpecial (All Prompts) variants. Exports QUICK_ACTIONS default set.
intent: Suggested action chips surfaced by the AI agent — quick-access prompts before the user types. Hide after first message.
usage: Use in the idle state of AICommandCenter before any message is sent
Use to surface 4–8 domain-specific suggested prompts relevant to the user's context
Use the `isSpecial` "All Prompts" chip as the last item to surface the full prompt library
doNotUse: Do not show chips after the first message is sent (hide when `hasMessages = true`)
Do not use more than 8 chips — scanning cost outweighs discoverability benefit
Do not use generic neutral buttons — chips must use `AIChipQuick` styling
